solutions.title: A solution for every level of operation.
solutions.sub: From essential fleet control to operations that need advanced telematics, video and electronic security.
solutions.pageIntro: IRON GPS launches with four deliberately focused solutions, grouped into two lines: IRON FLEET, for intelligence and control of commercial fleets; and IRON SECURITY, for electronic protection of higher-risk assets.
solutions.lineFleetDesc: Intelligence and control for commercial fleets. Turns vehicle data into actionable information: route compliance, usage, driver behavior and fuel and cargo control.
solutions.lineSecurityDesc: Electronic protection for mobile assets. Combines physical security with telematics and IoT: location informs, control acts and prior validation reduces risk.

items.name: IRON TRACK
items.desc: The starting point: real-time location, geofences, basic alerts and reports to start taking control of your operation.

items.name: IRON CONTROL
items.desc: Advanced GPS with door, fuel and temperature sensors, driver identification and custom alerts.

items.name: IRON VISION
items.desc: Video telematics: dashcam and cabin camera, on-demand video and risky-driving event detection.

items.name: IRON SECURE
items.desc: Electronic protection: GPS + door sensor + lock + solenoid + controller + panic button, with response procedures.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.q: What vehicles and assets can I manage?
items.a: Personal, commercial and cargo vehicles, transport, enterprise fleets, machinery and high-value assets — with or without GPS via BLE technology.

items.q: Does IRON GPS work for small businesses?
items.a: Yes. IRON TRACK is designed as an entry point for a few vehicles, and the solution scales as you grow.

items.q: Can I manage a large fleet?
items.a: Yes. The platform is scalable and ready for operations with many assets and users.

items.q: Can I see my vehicles in real time?
items.a: Yes, from the web platform and the native iOS and Android apps.

items.q: Can I get alerts and review history?
items.a: Yes. You set event-based alerts and review trips and historical data whenever you need.

items.q: Can I manage different vehicle types at once?
items.a: Yes. A single account can combine vehicles, fleets and assets of different types.

items.q: Will it alert me when insurance or inspection expires?
items.a: Yes. The platform manages document expirations (insurance, technical inspection, licenses) and alerts you in advance to avoid fines and penalties.
Yes. With the right sensors you can analyze consumption and detect possible losses or siphoning, even across multiple tanks.
Yes. We have a monitoring center, event response procedures and evidence, plus security rounds and access control.

items.q: Does the solution work in Colombia?
items.a: Yes. IRON GPS operates in Colombia and supports your operation locally.

items.q: How much does IRON GPS cost?
items.a: The cost depends on factors like number of vehicles, device type, features, installation and the service level required. The best way to define it is to first understand your operation — request a consultation and we’ll prepare a proposal.
Of course. Request an advisory session or demo and we'll show the solution for your case.
It depends on fleet size, vehicle type, the solution selected and the scope of implementation.

items.q: What support do I get after installation?
items.a: The scope of support depends on the service contracted. Our goal is to support you so the solution keeps generating value after implementation.

about.title: About us
about.heading: We exist to close the gap between having GPS and having control.
about.intro: Most companies with GPS today know where their vehicle is, but not whether it's being used properly, whether there's a risk of loss, or whether a driver has risky behavior. That's the gap IRON GPS exists to close.
about.narrativeQuote: At IRON GPS we believe managing a vehicle shouldn't just mean knowing where it is. It should mean being in control.
narrative: We were founded to close a specific gap: many companies already have a GPS, but still lack answers — they don't know if a vehicle is being used properly, if there's a risk of loss, or if an operation could run more efficiently. A dot on a map, but no control.

That's why we bring platform, our own installation, monitoring and support together in one service — with two paths available: full self-management from our platform, or our monitoring center working on your behalf.
about.purpose: That every person and every company has real control over what matters most to them: peace of mind, backed by information, not uncertainty.
about.mission: Help people and companies protect and manage their vehicles, fleets and assets, turning their information into more security, control and efficiency.
about.vision: To be the reference company in intelligent mobility and asset management in Colombia, with national presence and the start of our expansion into Ecuador and Panama.
